target_customer: Fraud and risk teams at fintechs and financial institutions
problem: Fraud operations teams cannot investigate every alert fast enough, and manual case work takes hours.
business_model: Usage based API pricing and enterprise software
product_category: AI fraud investigation and risk decisioning

founders.name: Jason Fan
founders.background_notes: YC page: former security and product lead at Robinhood who built the fraud investigations platform.

founders.name: Ayan Bandyopadhyay
founders.background_notes: YC page: former software engineer at Robinhood.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that run investigation procedures over structured and unstructured data, and later a calibrated decision model, need LLM engineering and careful evaluation.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations into fraud workflows create some lock in, but incumbents like Unit21 and Sardine can add agents and the company's claims are self reported.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; comparison sources describe these as adjacent layers.

market_need_then: The founders worked on fraud at Robinhood; a Fondo post says they cut account takeover losses by 95 percent there. No spend data from 2023 was found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and technical, with short headlines and bold performance claims.

branding.brand_signature: A detective emoji in launch titles

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself was found, and directories describe the company inconsistently.

pivots.from: AI agents that investigate financial fraud cases
pivots.to: Grayson, a decision model returning calibrated risk scores by API
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page shows the shift from an investigation tool to a decision model without calling it a pivot.

outcome_analysis: Finic launched fraud investigation agents from ex Robinhood founders, then moved toward a scoring API built on its own decision model. No funding was found in any source, and benchmark claims on its site come from a single test at one large customer. The company is active with four people, so the outcome is still open.
notes: The YC page shows Founded 2025 with a Winter 2023 batch, which is inconsistent; founded_year uses the batch. Fondo post is dated February 9, 2026. No dated competitor sources near early 2023 were found, so the list is empty. Third party directories describe the company inconsistently and were not used.
